areasLabel: Areas to judge (area tokens, separated by commas)
description: A target over a measurement, judged in every area on its own, with an error budget. The city-wide figure can pass while one district fails; this page shows both.
incomplete: {{count}} area(s) reported nothing and are left out of the spread.
noAreas: Name at least one area to judge.
notEnabled: Outcome evaluation is an experimental feature and is not enabled on this instance. An operator can turn it on with experimental.outcomes in the event-management settings.
pooledHint: Every bucket of every area together. Hides a failing area.
rule: The {{aggregation}} {{metric}} of each {{interval}}-minute bucket is {{comparator}} {{threshold}} in at least {{objective}} of the last {{minutes}} minutes.
spreadBreached: Over the allowed spread between the median area and the worst.
spreadUndefined: Fewer than two areas reported, so there is no spread.
title: Outcomes
